::: {.callout-note .se-question appearance="simple"}
## The question

[Is it possible to use an external editor with TeXShop, while keeping its sync features?](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/18142/is-it-possible-to-use-an-external-editor-with-texshop-while-keeping-its-sync-fe), asked by [fudo](https://tex.stackexchange.com/users/5075/fudo) on TeX Stack Exchange (2011-05-13; [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/)):

> I'm not completely satisfied with TeXShop's internal editor (especially about [line breaking](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/16510/indentation-and-line-wraps-in-texshop)), but I would like to keep using TeXShop for its neat visualization engine and sync features (inverse and forward search). Is it possible to keep those functionalities, or at least a decent inverse search, while using an external editor with TeXShop? If so, do you have any suggestions about a suitable editor for Mac?
:::

Take a look at this [page about using TeXShop with an external editor](http://ftp2.pl.freebsd.org/pub/TeX/TeXShop/texshop%202.26/TeXShop.app/Contents/Resources/Dutch.lproj/TeXShopHelp/pgs/advanced_externaleditor.htm).  You can configure TeXShop to open files in another editor, and if that editor can run unix commands, TeXShop provides executables for its interactive compiling.
